Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by rising 10-year Treasury yields hitting 2007 highs. This is bad news for growth-oriented tech and chip names like yours, as higher rates make future earnings less attractive and borrowing more expensive.

Your holdings: SOXL (-60.26%) and SPAL (-33.64%) are in dire straits. Both are leveraged ETFs, prone to decay, and on "SELL" status. With margin, these drawdowns hurt extra. SMH (-14.91%) is also on "TRIM" and very close to its stop.

Watch: Keep a close eye on how tech and chip stocks react to continued pressure from rising Treasury yields. Also, monitor any further news on a potential AI slowdown, which could directly impact your core holdings.

Bottom line: Focus on aggressive risk management, especially on your leveraged and underperforming positions, given the challenging market backdrop.
plays: Reduce exposure to SOXL and SPAL immediately, given their "SELL" status, leveraged decay, and significant losses. Respect their stops or consider a deeper trim.
SMH is on "TRIM" and near its stop at 540. Be ready to act if it breaks this level.
Consider SOXS (entry 50.55-50.5, stop 50.07) as a potential hedge against your concentrated chip exposure, given the negative market sentiment for tech.
